home.emptyBody: Create one to start playing. Cairn downloads Minecraft, the mod loader and Java for you.

instances.title: Instances
instances.subtitle: Each instance has its own mods, worlds and settings

wizard.title: New instance
wizard.loaderAuto: The latest stable build is picked for you: {{version}}
wizard.name: Instance name
wizard.willDownload: After you click Create, Cairn downloads
wizard.willDownloadNote: Java, the game, libraries and assets are all handled for you.

launch.noAccountBody: You need a Microsoft account (or an offline account for testing) to play.
launch.crashBody: Exit code {{code}}. These are the last lines it printed:

detail.vanillaNoMods: Vanilla instances have no mods. Pick a loader when creating an instance to add mods.
detail.noMods: No mods yet. Put .jar files in the mods folder.
detail.deleteBody: The instance folder is moved to Cairn's trash folder, not erased, so its worlds can still be recovered.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Follows your system until you pick one
settings.threadsHint: More threads are faster; lower it on a weak connection. Applies after a restart.
settings.offlineHint: Offline accounts are for testing and single-player only.
settings.license: Licensed under GPL-3.0. Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
